about: Each state's thresholds for statewide ballot measures and judicial retentions, read from its constitution or statute by worker D3's readers on 2026-11-07 (briefs/D3-data-local.md step 4; the orchestrator, 2026-11-07 06:16: 'Read statewide thresholds from each constitution or statute, with URLs'). Every quote was checked against the page saved when it was read, except where read_via says otherwise. t is the yes share of those voting on the question that the measure needs; compound, where set, is a rule that turns on more than that share, and p is not computed for it. only_if marks an exception that turns on what the measure does. The texts are those in force when read: applying them to 2016-2024 reads each section as in force then [inferred], except where from_year says otherwise. Used by pipeline/measures.py. Rules with read_in were read in step (a), with the ballot texts (data/measure/ballot-texts.json): Georgia's referendums on tax-exemption Acts and Rhode Island's bond acts of 2018, 2022 and 2024 (the orchestrator, 2026-11-07 14:21); to_year, where set, closes a rule's years. proposer, where set, names who puts the questions a rule governs on the ballot (legislature, initiative, referendum by petition, revision), read by D3 from the rule's own words and its applies_to, so that a question is cited to the rule that governs its kind where several rules set the same share (the orchestrator, 2026-11-07 14:36).

rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment proposed by legislature (two-thirds of each house); Alaska has no constitutional initiative
rules.rule: majority of the votes cast on the proposition (exactly half is not a majority)
rules.quote: If a majority of the votes cast on the proposition favor the amendment, it shall be adopted.

rules.applies_to: initiated statute and referred act (rejection of a referred act)
rules.rule: majority of the votes cast on the proposition
rules.quote: If a majority of the votes cast on the proposition favor its adoption, the initiated measure is enacted. If a majority of the votes cast on the proposition favor the rejection of an act referred, it is rejected.

rules.applies_to: state debt (general obligation bond question)
rules.rule: majority of the qualified voters who vote on the question
rules.quote: No state debt shall be contracted unless authorized by law for capital improvements or unless authorized by law for housing loans for veterans, and ratified by a majority of the qualified voters of the State who vote on the question.

rules.applies_to: constitutional convention question (2022)
rules.rule: majority of the votes cast on the question in the affirmative calls a convention
rules.quote: If a majority of the votes cast on the question are in the negative, the question need not be placed on the ballot until the end of the next ten-year period. If a majority of the votes cast on the question are in the affirmative, delegates to the convention shall be chosen at the next regular statewide election

rules.applies_to: judicial retention (supreme court justice, superior court judge)
rules.rule: judge is out only if rejected by a majority of those voting on the question; so retained with at least half yes (a tie does not reject)
rules.quote: The office of any supreme court justice or superior court judge becomes vacant ninety days after the election at which he is rejected by a majority of those voting on the question, or for which he fails to file his declaration of candidacy to succeed himself.

rules.compound: text reads 'majority of the electors voting at such election'; the base (ballots on the amendment, or all ballots at the election) is not stated here. Amendment 7 states the initiative rule differently (see next object)
rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment proposed by the General Assembly
rules.rule: majority of the electors voting at such election (text says 'at such election', not 'on the amendment'; it does not say which base is counted)
rules.quote: if a majority of the electors voting at such election adopt such amendments, the same shall become a part of this Constitution.

rules.applies_to: initiated constitutional amendment, initiated act, and referred measure
rules.rule: majority of the votes cast upon the measure; expressly not required to be a majority of electors voting at the election
rules.quote: Any measure submitted to the people as herein provided shall take effect and become a law when approved by a majority of the votes cast upon such measure, and not otherwise, and shall not be required to receive a majority of the electors voting at such election.
rules.only_if: an amendment the people initiated (Amendment 7)

rules.applies_to: initiated constitutional amendment, initiated act, and referred measure
rules.rule: majority of the votes cast upon the measure; expressly not required to be a majority of electors voting at the election
rules.quote: Any measure submitted to the people as herein provided shall take effect and become a law when approved by a majority of the votes cast upon such measure, and not otherwise, and shall not be required to receive a majority of the electors voting at such election.

rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment, any proposer (legislature or initiative), that approves a tax (2022 Prop 132 rule)
rules.rule: 60% of qualified electors voting thereon
rules.quote: for any proposed amendment or amendments to approve a tax, if sixty percent of the qualified electors voting thereon shall approve and ratify such proposed amendment or amendments in the regular or special election, such amendment or amendments shall become a part of this constitution
rules.only_if: an amendment that approves a tax

rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment, any proposer, not approving a tax (exception to the 60% rule)
rules.rule: majority of qualified electors voting thereon
rules.quote: and for any other proposed amendment or amendments, if a majority of the qualified electors voting thereon shall approve and ratify such proposed amendment or amendments in the regular or special election, such amendment or amendments shall become a part of this constitution.

rules.applies_to: initiated or referred statute (and initiated constitutional amendment) that approves a tax
rules.rule: 60% of the votes cast thereon
rules.quote: for an initiative or referendum to approve a tax, shall become law when approved by sixty percent of the votes cast thereon and upon proclamation of the governor, and not otherwise
rules.only_if: an initiative or referendum that approves a tax

rules.applies_to: initiated or referred statute (and initiated constitutional amendment) that does not approve a tax
rules.rule: majority of the votes cast thereon
rules.quote: and for all other initiatives and referendums, shall become law when approved by a majority of the votes cast thereon and upon proclamation of the governor, and not otherwise.

rules.compound: calling the convention: approval 'by the people on a Referendum vote', share not stated; proposals from the convention: majority of electors voting thereon
rules.applies_to: constitutional convention (referendum on the law calling one, and convention proposals)
rules.rule: laws calling a convention must first be approved by the people on a referendum vote; convention proposals need a majority of electors voting thereon. No percentage stated for the first vote.
rules.quote: No Convention shall be called by the Legislature to propose alterations, revisions, or amendments to this Constitution, or to propose a new Constitution, unless laws providing for such Convention shall first be approved by the people on a Referendum vote at a regular or special election

rules.applies_to: judicial retention (supreme, appellate, superior court judges)
rules.rule: retained if a majority of those voting on the question votes Yes; vacancy if a majority votes No. A tie is not addressed in the text.
rules.quote: If a majority of those voting on the question votes "No," then, upon the expiration of the term for which such justice or judge was serving, a vacancy shall exist, which shall be filled as provided by this article. If a majority of those voting on the question votes "Yes," such justice or judge shall remain in office for another term

rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment (statute C.R.S. 1-40-123(3) as amended by SB17-152; the constitution text itself was NOT read)
rules.rule: at least 55% of votes cast thereon
rules.citation: C.R.S. 1-40-123(3), as enacted by 2017 Colo. Sess. Laws ch. 169 (SB17-152), §7 (capitals in the source are its way of marking new text)
rules.quote: AT LEAST FIFTY-FIVE PERCENT OF THE VOTES CAST THEREON ADOPTS ANY MEASURE SUBMITTED FOR AN AMENDMENT TO THE STATE CONSTITUTION; EXCEPT THAT A MAJORITY OF THE VOTES CAST THEREON ADOPTS ANY MEASURE SUBMITTED FOR AN AMENDMENT TO THE STATE CONSTITUTION THAT ONLY REPEALS IN WHOLE OR IN PART ANY PROVISION OF THE STATE CONSTITUTION.

rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment that only repeals, in whole or in part, a provision of the constitution (exception)
rules.rule: majority of votes cast thereon
rules.quote: EXCEPT THAT A MAJORITY OF THE VOTES CAST THEREON ADOPTS ANY MEASURE SUBMITTED FOR AN AMENDMENT TO THE STATE CONSTITUTION THAT ONLY REPEALS IN WHOLE OR IN PART ANY PROVISION OF THE STATE CONSTITUTION.
rules.only_if: an amendment that only repeals, in whole or in part, a provision of the constitution

rules.applies_to: initiated or referred statute (proposed law)
rules.rule: majority of the votes cast thereon
rules.quote: A majority of the votes cast thereon ADOPTS ANY MEASURE SUBMITTED FOR A PROPOSED LAW

rules.applies_to: initiative measure
rules.rule: ratified by a majority of the registered qualified electors voting on the measure
rules.quote: An initiative measure which has been ratified by a majority of the registered qualified electors voting on the measure shall not take effect until the end of the 30-day congressional review period

rules.applies_to: referendum on an act of the Council (rejection)
rules.rule: act is rejected if a majority of registered qualified electors voting in the referendum vote to disapprove
rules.quote: If a majority of the registered qualified electors voting in a referendum on an act or part or parts thereof vote to disapprove the act or part or parts thereof, then such action shall be deemed a rejection of the act or part or parts thereof

rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment or revision (any proposer: legislature, initiative, commissions, convention), general rule
rules.rule: at least 60% of the electors voting on the measure
rules.quote: Unless otherwise specifically provided for elsewhere in this constitution, if the proposed amendment or revision is approved by vote of at least sixty percent of the electors voting on the measure, it shall be effective as an amendment to or revision of the constitution

rules.compound: two-thirds of the voters voting in the election, not only of those voting on the measure
rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment imposing a new State tax or fee (exception to 60%)
rules.rule: not fewer than two-thirds of the voters voting in the election (text says 'in the election in which such proposed amendment is considered', not 'on the measure'); a failing amendment is void
rules.quote: no new State tax or fee shall be imposed on or after November 8, 1994 by any amendment to this constitution unless the proposed amendment is approved by not fewer than two-thirds of the voters voting in the election in which such proposed amendment is considered.
rules.only_if: an amendment that imposes a new State tax or fee

rules.compound: text sets no vote share
rules.applies_to: state bonds pledging full faith and credit
rules.rule: approval by a vote of the electors; no share is stated in the text
rules.quote: State bonds pledging the full faith and credit of the state may be issued only to finance or refinance the cost of state fixed capital outlay projects authorized by law, and purposes incidental thereto, upon approval by a vote of the electors

rules.applies_to: constitutional convention question
rules.rule: majority voting on the question
rules.quote: If a majority voting on the question votes in the affirmative, at the next succeeding general election there shall be elected from each representative district a member of a constitutional convention.

rules.applies_to: judicial retention (justices and judges)
rules.rule: retained if a majority of the qualified electors voting within the territorial jurisdiction of the court vote to retain
rules.quote: If a majority of the qualified electors voting within the territorial jurisdiction of the court vote to retain, the justice or judge shall be retained for a term of six years.

rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment proposed by the General Assembly (two-thirds of each house); Georgia has no initiative
rules.rule: majority of the electors qualified to vote for General Assembly members voting thereon (edition read is the 2016 annotated edition)
rules.quote: If such proposal is ratified by a majority of the electors qualified to vote for members of the General Assembly voting thereon in such general election, such proposal shall become a part of this Constitution or shall become a new Constitution, as the case may be.

rules.applies_to: constitutional convention proposals
rules.rule: ratified the same way as legislative proposals (majority of electors voting thereon)
rules.quote: A proposal by the convention to amend this Constitution or for a new Constitution shall be advertised, submitted to, and ratified by the people in the same manner provided for advertisement, submission, and ratification of proposals to amend the Constitution by the General Assembly.

rules.applies_to: a general Act of the General Assembly exempting property from ad valorem taxation, put to the voters of the whole state
rules.rule: a majority of the qualified electors of the state voting in a referendum thereon
rules.quote: (a)(1) Except as otherwise provided in this Constitution, no property shall be exempted from ad valorem taxation unless the exemption is approved by two-thirds of the members elected to each branch of the General Assembly in a roll-call vote and by a majority of the qualified electors of the state voting in a referendum thereon.
rules.only_if: a general Act exempting property from ad valorem taxation, put to the state's voters
rules.read_in: step (a), with the ballot texts (data/measure/ballot-texts.json); each such Act's own section 3 says the same in votes cast: 'If more than one-half of the votes cast on ... such question are for approval of the Act' (HB 820 of 2018, HB 808 of 2024, as saved; the gap is the bill's line number or page break)

rules.compound: majority of the votes tallied on the question, and that majority must be at least 50% of the total vote cast at the election
rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment proposed by legislature, and revisions or amendments proposed by convention, at a general election
rules.rule: majority of all votes tallied upon the question, and that majority at least 50% of the total vote cast at the election
rules.citation: Haw. Const. art. XVII, §2 (ratification paragraph); §3 for the legislature
rules.quote: The revision or amendments shall be effective only if approved at a general election by a majority of all the votes tallied upon the question, this majority constituting at least fifty per cent of the total vote cast at the election, or at a special election by a majority of all the votes tallied upon the question, this majority constituting at least thirty per cent of the total number of registered voters.

rules.applies_to: constitutional convention question (2018)
rules.rule: majority of the ballots cast upon the question in the affirmative
rules.quote: If a majority of the ballots cast upon such a question be in the affirmative, delegates to the convention shall be chosen at the next regular election unless the legislature shall provide for the election of delegates at a special election.

rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment proposed by the General Assembly (no initiative in Iowa)
rules.rule: majority of electors voting on the amendment
rules.quote: if the people shall approve and ratify such amendment or amendments, by a majority of the electors qualified to vote for members of the General Assembly, voting thereon, such amendment or amendments shall become a part of the Constitution of this State.

rules.applies_to: constitutional convention question
rules.rule: majority voting on the question
rules.citation: Iowa Const. art. X, §3 (as substituted by Amendment 22 of 1964)
rules.quote: in case a majority of the electors so qualified, voting at such election, for and against such proposition, shall decide in favor of a Convention for such purpose, the General Assembly, at its next session, shall provide by law for the election of delegates

rules.applies_to: state debt law (statewide bond question)
rules.rule: majority of votes cast for and against
rules.quote: no such law shall take effect until at a general election it shall have been submitted to the people, and have received a majority of all the votes cast for and against it at such election

rules.applies_to: judicial retention (supreme court, court of appeals, district court judges)
rules.rule: more affirmative than negative votes. Iowa Const. art. V, §17 puts judges on a retention ballot but states no threshold; the threshold is in the statute.
rules.quote: A judge of the supreme court, court of appeals, or district court including a district associate judge, full-time associate juvenile judge, or full-time associate probate judge, or a clerk of the district court must receive more affirmative than negative votes to be retained in office.

rules.compound: majority of 'the electors'; denominator not stated in the text I read
rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment proposed by the legislature
rules.rule: text says only 'a majority of the electors shall ratify'; the denominator (voting on it, or all electors voting at the election) is not stated in the section
rules.quote: and if a majority of the electors shall ratify the same, such amendment or amendments shall become a part of this Constitution.

rules.applies_to: initiated statute and referendum measure
rules.rule: majority of those voting on the measure (statute; Const. art. III, §1 leaves conditions to the legislature)
rules.quote: declaring such measures as are approved by a majority of those voted thereon to be in full force and effect as the law of the state of Idaho

rules.applies_to: state debt law (statewide bond question)
rules.rule: majority of all votes cast for or against
rules.quote: no such law shall take effect until at a general election it shall have been submitted to the people, and shall have received a majority of all the votes cast for or against it at such election

rules.compound: majority of all the electors voting at the election (share of all ballots at the election, not only of those voting on the question)
rules.applies_to: constitutional convention question
rules.rule: majority of all electors voting at the election
rules.quote: if a majority of all the electors voting at said election shall have voted for a convention, the legislature shall at the next session provide by law for calling the same

rules.compound: three-fifths of those voting on the amendment, or a majority of those voting in the election
rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment by initiative (Article IV amendments only)
rules.rule: three-fifths of those voting on the amendment, or a majority of those voting in the election. NOT read from the constitution site; this is the Illinois Supreme Court's quotation of the section.
rules.citation: Ill. Const. art. XIV, §3, as quoted in Hooker v. Illinois State Board of Elections, 2016 IL 121077, ¶99
rules.quote: shall become effective if approved by either three-fifths of those voting on the amendment or a majority of those voting in the election.
rules.only_if: an amendment to Article IV the people initiated

rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment proposed by the General Assembly (no initiative in Kentucky)
rules.rule: majority of votes cast for and against
rules.quote: If it shall appear that a majority of the votes cast for and against an amendment at said election was for the amendment, then the same shall become a part of the Constitution of this Commonwealth

rules.applies_to: state debt act (statewide bond question)
rules.rule: majority of all votes cast for and against
rules.quote: nor shall such act take effect until it shall have been submitted to the people at a general election, and shall have received a majority of all the votes cast for and against it

rules.compound: majority voting on the proposition, plus a turnout floor: yes votes must equal one-fourth of those who voted at the last general election
rules.applies_to: constitutional convention question
rules.rule: majority voting on the proposition AND yes votes at least one-fourth of the voters at the last general election
rules.quote: If it shall appear that a majority voting on the proposition was for calling a Convention, and if the total number of votes cast for the calling of the Convention is equal to one-fourth of the number of qualified voters who voted at the last preceding general election in this State

rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment proposed by the legislature (no initiative in Louisiana)
rules.rule: majority of electors voting on the amendment
rules.quote: If a majority of the electors voting on the proposed amendment approve it, the governor shall proclaim its adoption, and it shall become part of this constitution, effective twenty days after the proclamation, unless the amendment provides otherwise.

rules.compound: majority statewide and also a majority in each affected parish (or each affected municipality)
rules.applies_to: exception: amendment directly affecting not more than five parishes (or areas within them), or not more than five municipalities
rules.rule: majority statewide AND majority in each affected parish or municipality
rules.quote: shall become part of this constitution only when approved by a majority of the electors voting thereon in the state and also a majority of the electors voting thereon in each affected parish.
rules.only_if: an amendment directly affecting not more than five parishes or five municipalities

rules.applies_to: constitution or revision proposed by a constitutional convention
rules.rule: majority of electors voting
rules.quote: If the proposal is approved by a majority of the electors voting thereon, the governor shall proclaim it to be the Constitution of Louisiana.

rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment proposed by the legislature (no initiative for amendments)
rules.rule: majority of inhabitants voting on the question
rules.quote: if it shall appear that a majority of the inhabitants voting on the question are in favor of such amendment, it shall become a part of this Constitution.

rules.applies_to: people's veto referendum on an act
rules.rule: majority of electors voting thereon
rules.quote: that the same have been ratified by a majority of the electors voting thereon at a statewide or general election.

rules.applies_to: measure referred to the people (direct initiative or referendum)
rules.rule: majority of votes given thereon
rules.quote: approved by a majority of the votes given thereon shall, unless a later date is specified in said measure, take effect and become a law in 30 days after the Governor has made public proclamation of the result of the vote

rules.compound: runoff rule for competing measures: neither has a majority, the leader needs more than 1/3 to go to a later statewide election by itself
rules.applies_to: exception: initiative with competing legislative measure, neither gets a majority of votes given for or against both
rules.rule: most-voted measure goes to a later runoff if it gets more than 1/3 of the votes given for and against both
rules.quote: When there are competing bills and neither receives a majority of the votes given for or against both, the one receiving the most votes shall at the next statewide election
rules.only_if: an initiative with a competing measure on the same ballot

rules.applies_to: statewide bond question
rules.rule: 2/3 of both houses, then ratified by majority of electors voting thereon
rules.quote: by proper enactment ratified by a majority of the electors voting thereon at a general or special election, the Legislature may authorize the issuance of bonds on behalf of the State

rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment proposed by the legislature
rules.rule: majority of electors voting on the amendment
rules.quote: If a majority of electors voting on a proposed amendment approve the same, it shall become part of the constitution

rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment proposed by initiative petition
rules.rule: majority of electors voting on the question
rules.quote: If the proposed amendment is approved by a majority of the electors voting on the question, it shall become part of the constitution

rules.applies_to: initiated law and referendum on an act
rules.rule: majority of votes cast thereon
rules.quote: Any law submitted to the people by either initiative or referendum petition and approved by a majority of the votes cast thereon at any election shall take effect 10 days after the date of the official declaration of the vote.

rules.applies_to: state long-term borrowing question
rules.rule: 2/3 of each house, then approved by majority of electors voting thereon
rules.quote: adopted by a vote of two-thirds of the members elected to and serving in each house, and approved by a majority of the electors voting thereon at any general election.

rules.applies_to: constitutional convention question (and convention's proposed constitution)
rules.rule: majority of electors voting on the question; proposed constitution by majority of qualified electors voting thereon
rules.quote: If a majority of the electors voting on the question decide in favor of a convention for such purpose

rules.compound: majority of all the electors voting at the election (a blank on the question counts against)
rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment proposed by the legislature (no initiative in Minnesota)
rules.rule: majority of all electors voting at the election
rules.quote: If a majority of all the electors voting at the election vote to ratify an amendment, it becomes a part of this constitution.

rules.compound: majority of all the electors voting at the election
rules.applies_to: constitutional convention question
rules.rule: majority of all electors voting at the election
rules.quote: If a majority of all the electors voting at the election vote for a convention, the legislature at its next session, shall provide by law for calling the convention.

rules.applies_to: revision proposed by a constitutional convention
rules.rule: three-fifths of electors voting on the question
rules.quote: If three-fifths of all the electors voting on the question vote to ratify the revision, it becomes a new constitution of the state of Minnesota.
rules.only_if: a revision proposed by a constitutional convention

rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment proposed by the General Assembly or by initiative
rules.rule: majority of votes cast thereon
rules.quote: If a majority of the votes cast thereon is in favor of any amendment, the same shall take effect at the end of thirty days after the election.

rules.applies_to: initiated statute
rules.rule: majority of votes cast thereon
rules.quote: Except as provided in this constitution, any measure proposed shall take effect when approved by a majority of the votes cast thereon.

rules.applies_to: measure referred to the people (referendum)
rules.rule: majority of votes cast thereon
rules.quote: Any measure referred to the people shall take effect when approved by a majority of the votes cast thereon, and not otherwise.

rules.applies_to: constitutional convention question (every twenty years, 2022)
rules.rule: majority of votes cast thereon
rules.quote: if a majority of the votes cast thereon is for the affirmative, the governor shall call an election of delegates to the convention

rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment proposed by the legislature
rules.rule: majority of electors voting thereon
rules.quote: If approved by a majority of the electors voting thereon, the amendment shall become a part of this constitution on the first day of July after certification of the election returns unless the amendment provides otherwise.

rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment proposed by initiative
rules.rule: majority voting thereon
rules.quote: If approved by a majority voting thereon, it shall become a part of the constitution effective the first day of July following its approval, unless the amendment provides otherwise.

rules.applies_to: initiated statute and referred act (statewide ballot issues); Const. art. III §§4-5 state no vote threshold, statute does
rules.rule: approved by a majority of those voting on the issue
rules.quote: the effective date of each statewide ballot issue approved by a majority of those voting on the issue.

rules.applies_to: state debt (statewide bond question)

rules.quote: No state debt shall be created unless authorized by a two-thirds vote of the members of each house of the legislature or a majority of the electors voting thereon.

rules.compound: threshold not read
rules.applies_to: judicial retention (unopposed incumbent supreme court justice or district judge)
rules.rule: threshold not stated. The constitution says voters 'approve or reject' the incumbent; MCA 13-14-212 gives the ballot form (yes/no) only. No vote share found.
rules.citation: Mont. Const. art. VII, §8(3); Mont. Code Ann. §13-14-212
rules.quote: If an incumbent files for election and there is no election contest for the office, the name of the incumbent shall nevertheless be placed on the general election ballot to allow the voters of the state or district to approve or reject him.

rules.applies_to: constitutional amendment (legislature-proposed); no initiative or statutory referendum exists in NC
rules.rule: majority of votes cast thereon
rules.quote: If a majority of the votes cast thereon are in favor of the proposed new or revised Constitution or constitutional amendment or amendments, it or they shall become effective January first next after ratification by the voters unless a different effective date is prescribed in the act submitting the proposal or proposals to the qualified voters.

rules.applies_to: convention question
rules.rule: majority of votes cast on the proposition
rules.quote: If a majority of the votes cast upon the proposition are in favor of a Convention, it shall assemble on the day prescribed by the General Assembly.

rules.applies_to: state bond question (debt secured by faith and credit)
rules.rule: majority of qualified voters who vote thereon
rules.quote: The General Assembly shall have no power to contract debts secured by a pledge of the faith and credit of the State, unless approved by a majority of the qualified voters of the State who vote thereon, except for the following purposes:

rules.quote: If a majority of votes cast upon an initiated or a referred measure are affirmative, it shall be deemed enacted.

rules.applies_to: initiated or referred statute (and, by sec. 9, initiated constitutional amendment)
rules.rule: majority of votes cast upon the measure
rules.citation: N.D. Const. art. III, sec. 8 (and sec. 9)
rules.quote: If a majority of votes cast upon an initiated or a referred measure are affirmative, it shall be deemed enacted.
